wc_bk_locked_intro: This is the same zip as Export all my work, closed with a passphrase. Only the passphrase opens it, so the file is safe to keep in email or a cloud drive.
wc_bk_need_unlock: Unlock your vault first, then make the backup again.
wc_bk_fail: Could not make the backup. Check your connection and try again.
wc_bk_done: Locked backup downloaded. Keep the passphrase safe: it cannot be recovered.
wc_bk_check_intro: Choose a backup file, plain or locked. It is read in this browser and nothing in the app is changed. Checking one proves you can get your work back.
wc_bk_check_locked: This file is locked. Type the passphrase you chose when you made it.
wc_bk_check_ok: This backup file can be read. Projects: {p}. Documents: {n}. Saved {d}. Nothing in the app was changed.
wc_bk_check_ok_locked: This locked backup opened with that passphrase and can be read. Projects: {p}. Documents: {n}. Saved {d}. Nothing in the app was changed.
wc_bk_check_bad: This backup file has problems. Projects: {p}. Documents: {n}. Saved {d}.
wc_bk_prob_unreadable: Could not be opened when the backup was made, so it has no files: {name}
